data_type_evidence: Experiment folder exploration found a flat structure with real runner/data files and result artifacts, including 2026_bi_align__h-e1__code__data_loader.py, 2026_bi_align__h-m2__code__run_experiment.py, 2026_bi_align__h-m4__code__experiment.log, 2026_bi_align__h-e1__experiment_results.json, 2026_bi_align__h-m3__results__delta_results.json, and 2026_bi_align__h-m4__results__regression_results.json.
The paper explicitly states that the experiments use the Anthropic HH-RLHF helpfulness dataset and its three tiers (06_paper_refinement.md:5, 39-47, 107-110).

The h-e1 loader imports Hugging Face datasets and loads real data via datasets.load_dataset("Anthropic/hh-rlhf", data_dir=..., cache_dir=...) across helpful-base, helpful-rejection-sampled, and helpful-online (2026_bi_align__h-e1__code__data_loader.py:16-34).

The h-m4 loader again loads real HH-RLHF tiers with datasets.load_dataset("Anthropic/hh-rlhf", ...) inside split_by_tier(), then extracts conversation rows from ds["train"] (2026_bi_align__h-m4__code__data_loader.py:28-63).

Observed np.random usage is for control construction and resampling rather than synthetic dataset generation: build_random_control() only shuffles existing AI embeddings to form a random baseline (2026_bi_align__h-m2__code__controls.py:8-20), and bootstrap code resamples existing cosine arrays (2026_bi_align__h-m4__code__statistics.py:23-53).

Execution logs show real dataset access and extraction, not hardcoded arrays: h-m2 logs Hugging Face requests for Anthropic/hh-rlhf and then reports Tier helpful-base: 63830 pairs extracted, helpful-rejection-sampled: 65359 pairs extracted, helpful-online: 26173 pairs extracted (2026_bi_align__h-m2__code__experiment.log:3-36).

The h-m4 run log shows non-dry-run execution, Hugging Face dataset requests, and loaded counts for all three tiers: helpful-base 127708 rows, helpful-rejection-sampled 130726 rows, helpful-online 52352 rows for chosen+rejected branches (2026_bi_align__h-m4__code__experiment.log:1-37).

Saved results also record the real dataset and completed execution: dataset name Anthropic/hh-rlhf, splits [helpful-base, helpful-rejection-sampled, helpful-online], total_conversations 118263, total_pairs 155362, mock_data_detection.detected false, and full_experiment_completed true (2026_bi_align__h-e1__experiment_results.json:42-47, 53-57, 77).
